newDescriptorExplanation: Two section fields in each of3listing schemas, one product-detail field, one global typography field. Guide repair uses existing fields.
versionPolicy: Version-neutral private overlay on Main201. Themes must choose a successor/capture strategy before integration/distribution; do not overwrite captured201.

mapping.baseline: product-grid, collection-product-list and featured-products use the existing Pantry shelf list; two columns become one at the existing900px breakpoint. There is no selectable layout field.

proposal.effect: One column retains the same cards/order/content; responsive restores the existing grid. Conditional fixed CSS uses source-owned classes and is emitted only when selected.

mapping.baseline: Existing three-panel product layout with ingredients/allergen context before purchase; mobile already stacks the same children. No declared selectable layout.

proposal.effect: Stack the existing composition with full-width children. Food/allergen information stays ahead of the existing purchase region; no new purchase island or cart authority.

mapping.baseline: Inter/Inter with fixed16px body and scoped heading/support scales. Existing font/palette settings remain canonical.

proposal.effect: Comfortable increases the existing body and heading sizes12.5%, with fixed supporting food-text rules. No arbitrary CSS/font value; standard emits no extra CSS. Font family, colors and composition unchanged.

mapping.baseline: Cards retain title, image, net/pack guidance, server price/unit basis and availability. Validated common food.storage already reaches Liquid; no new commerce DTO is needed.

proposal.effect: Optionally show supplied common storage guidance before price. Absent storage stays absent. This control cannot hide price, availability, required net/pack guidance or PDP allergen warnings; variant labels do not invent net facts.

mapping.baseline: Blueprint requires a shelf-life policy, not an invented current expiry date. Canonical FoodFactsSchema has no expiry field. Existing CMS Page title/body/slug/published workflow plus about-section linkLabel/linkUrl already supplies the intended content route. However a valid link pair alone is hidden by the old content/image gate.

proposal.effect: Compatible private gate repair allows a complete link pair alone. Reuse merchant CMS Page with a nonreserved single slug such as /storage-and-shelf-life; store_url adds the current store scope. No new policy table, food schema, batch expiry or fabricated claim.

expandedCoverageAccounting: Existing281 composite obligations remain NOT_RUN. These mappings and future checks require reconciliation against the allocator-selected successor inventory;12 source cases are not lifecycle cases.
purchaseSafety: No required safety fact removal, sticky purchase bar, new cart/session path or provider call.
